sources.title: Notification of the Bank of Thailand No. 31/2568 Re: Financial institutions and specialized financial institutions’ holidays and additional special holiday for B.E. 2569 (2026) (unofficial translation)
sources.said: Thursday 1st January New Year’s Day; Friday 2nd January Additional special holiday (Cabinet resolution 12th November 2024); Tuesday 3rd March Makha Bucha Day; Monday 6th April Chakri Memorial Day; 13th, 14th, 15th April Songkran Festival; Friday 1st May National Labor Day; Monday 4th May Coronation Day; Monday 1st June Substitution for Visakha Bucha Day (Sunday 31st May 2026); Wednesday 3rd June H.M. Queen Suthida’s Birthday; Tuesday 28th July H.M. King Maha Vajiralongkorn’s Birthday; Wednesday 29th July Asarnha Bucha Day; Wednesday 12th August H.M. Queen Sirikit the Queen Mother’s Birthday and Mother’s Day; Tuesday 13th October H.M. King Bhumibol Adulyadej the Great Memorial Day; Friday 23rd October H.M. King Chulalongkorn the Great Memorial Day; Monday 7th December Substitution for H.M. King Bhumibol Adulyadej the Great’s Birthday, National Day and Father’s Day (Saturday 5th December 2026); Thursday 10th December Constitution Day; Thursday 31st December New Year’s Eve. For financial institutions and specialized financial institutions branches in Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, Satun, and Songkhla, extra holidays are given for Eid al – Fitr Day (Ramadan Day), Eid al – Adha Day (Raya Haji Day) announced by the Sheikhul Islam Office, and the Chinese New Year Day if the date does not fall on any of holidays listed above or Saturday and Sunday.

sources.title: Notification of the Bank of Thailand No. 26/2569 Re: Announcement of the additional special holiday for financial institutions and specialized financial institutions in Bangkok (unofficial translation)
sources.said: On 19th May 2026, the Cabinet announced a special public holiday in Bangkok ... for the 2026 Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank Group. The Bank of Thailand announces Friday 16th October 2026 as an additional special holiday for financial institutions and specialized financial institutions in Bangkok for one day.
